title: Video JS
subtitle: Ask an LLM for scenes written in JavaScript (2D canvas or 3D with three.js), preview them live, adjust them and export an MP4.
footer: {{scenes}} scenes · {{seconds}} s · scene code runs isolated, without network or access to HocusPocus.

presentation.label: Presentation
